auditor_role: Independent engineering/model source audit, not wet-lab expert gold.
input_separation: No current native reviewer, prior Workflow, prior scientific review, old repair graph or current final candidate was read. The packet and this fresh initial candidate supplied scientific authority. Host checklist metadata was encountered during file inspection, but the other agent's candidate/checklist audit was not used as the answer key. Nothing from this audit was supplied to running native workers.
scope: Describe the general published assay introduced by the primary publication, from native specimen through the declared readout and its decoding. Preserve source-defined applicability, consequential interfaces, variants and control/calibration dependencies. Independent characterization or historical study execution belongs only where needed to explain the assay. Attribute manufacturer and cited-method material to its actual supported scope.
claim_reading_scope: All actual Operation names/actions/information_effects, resource descriptions, declared inputs/outputs and binding basis/conditions/selection were read.
All State descriptions, Flow kinds/basis/conditions/selection and all 14 gap descriptions/next-evidence targets were read.

Attached source refs were expanded to their primary Methods/overview/caption contexts and original-author code where consequential. Repeated exact inventory rows were also mechanically compared with their source rows.
All eight Module membership/rationales were read as organization rather than additional chemical transformations.

mechanical_checks.boundary: These checks establish reference/text/representation integrity and exact transcription of checked inventories, not evidence entailment or universal biochemical feasibility.

candidate_claim.action: Inspect the same slide during or after barcoding to record channel/pixel placement relative to tissue anatomy.
candidate_claim.input_state_description: Intact tissue after the orthogonal B-flow: RNA- and ADT-derived DNA products carry covalently joined A/B codes defining 50×50 = 2,500 spatial pixels. B contributes a 10-nt UMI, 5′ biotin and PCR handle; positions remain tissue-localized until recovery.
candidate_claim.binding_condition: When the source-described same-slide optical registration is collected during or after the flow steps.

source_witnesses.locator: S32/p1 [P42] — Adding the first set of barcodes and reverse transcription; normalized chars 0:2233
source_witnesses.quote: During the flow barcoding step, optical images could be taken to record the exact positions of these microfluidic channels in relation to the tissue section subjected to spatial barcoding.

source_witnesses.locator: S33/p1 [P43] — Adding the second set of barcodes and ligation; normalized chars 0:1282
source_witnesses.quote: the images showing the location of the microfluidic channels on the tissue slide could be taken during the flow step

Afterwards, the second PDMS chip is removed and the tissue remains intact while spatially barcoded for all mRNAs and the proteins of interest. The barcoded tissue is imaged under an optical or fluorescence microscope to visualize individual pixels.

advisory_findings.reason: The action/condition permits during-flow imaging, including the source's first-flow capability, but its only material input is described specifically as post-B fully encoded tissue. The after-B imaging route is directly supported, so this does not demonstrate a fabricated imaging experiment or wrong core production chemistry. The graph does not separately expose the earlier-stage option to a stage-specific query.
advisory_findings.recommended_treatment: Either narrow this Operation/interface to the supported after-B route, or explicitly qualify/represent the earlier-stage alternatives if that broader capability is claimed. Do not force new routine-motion nodes or call the whole assay unsupported merely because the source offers several image times.

advisory_findings.reason: Several chemistry/information gaps overlap on the same unknowns; some gaps also bundle several dependency details. Retaining the exact reader lineage is reasonable, but 14 gap records are not 14 distinct missing scientific facts.
advisory_findings.recommended_treatment: Present overlapping gap themes together in an audit/navigation view while preserving original gap IDs and their provenance. Do not delete a genuine gap or silently rewrite frozen source/reader history.

source_checked_premises: The exact complementary linker is supplied; its amount/preannealing are not in the inspected quantitative ligation recipe. The candidate preserves the linker and uses a nonblocking recipe-detail gap.

The first-PCR primer-volume wording remains genuinely ambiguous at the text level; the candidate does not invent a final volume. Arithmetic could suggest a reading but does not by itself prove the author's executed recipe.
Manufacturer internals for B&W, SU-8 and Nextera are not represented as inspected protocol dependencies in this packet; known operation boundaries remain explicit.
The primary names an unspecified P7 choice and an unqualified 1:9 pool ratio; exact selected index and basis are not asserted.
The target/15-nt ADT identity table is preserved. A complete antibody-conjugate backbone and original ADT parser are distinct from that table.
Paper and README reference labels are attributed separately, without declaring the exact historical build established.
The script's 8-nt whitelist and the registered 16-nt pixel-coordinate table are distinct input interfaces; exact historical file identity is not assumed.
ST internal counting policy and product-specific normalization assignment remain delegated/qualified; known input/output and separately reported analysis choices are retained.
gap_assessment.boundary: A bounded packet-level absence assessment is not proof that authors never supplied the missing fact elsewhere. No open-web recovery or complete manufacturer/library implementation audit was performed.

positive_source_checked_behaviors: No added disposal/reuse fate of an unreported aliquot/remainder was found. The graph explicitly avoids inventing a qPCR analytical copy.
The long retained RNA bead fraction and short retained ADT supernatant remain distinct through their correct separate library continuations.
The PCR fluorescence plateau and manual under-tissue selection have explicit source-described decisions; ordinary Qubit/Bioanalyzer QC is precedence/observation, not an invented adaptive controller.
Template and barcode-bearing intermediates are material; sequencing counts and coordinate maps are data. Chemical species, retained identity and RNA-versus-ADT origin are kept distinct.
Optional fluorescence capability is not silently asserted as a demonstrated universal combination with the full joint 22-ADT production route.
Author code rules are attributed as documented examples; known source/build/layout tensions do not become invented historical executions or forced reconciliations.
